description: Open Login Manager In Test Mode
Open Login Manager In Test Mode (Installed)

command: uri=$(gio mount -li 2>/dev/null | grep -oE 'activation_root=mtp://[^[:space:]]+' | sed 's/^activation_root=//' | head -1); if [ -z "$uri" ]; then echo "No phone detected - plug in and choose File transfer on the device"; else gio mount "$uri" >/dev/null 2>&1; mp=$(find /run/user/$(id -u)/gvfs -maxdepth 1 -name 'mtp:host=*' | head -1); echo "Phone mounted at: $mp"; cd "$mp" 2>/dev/null && ls; fi

uri=$(gio mount -li 2>/dev/null | grep -oE 'activation_root=mtp://[^[:space:]]+' | sed 's/^activation_root=//' | head -1); [ -n "$uri" ] && gio mount -u "$uri" && echo "Phone unmounted." || echo "No phone mounted."
systemctl start mount-nas && echo "NAS mounted at: /mnt/nas"

description: Redefine Windows VM From Repo XML

command: ssid=$(nmcli -t -f SSID device wifi list --rescan yes | grep . | sort -u | fzf --prompt='Wi-Fi> '); [ -n "$ssid" ] && { nmcli -t -f NAME connection show | grep -qxF "$ssid" && known=1 || known=; nmcli --ask device wifi connect "$ssid" || { [ -z "$known" ] && nmcli connection delete id "$ssid" >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "Connect failed - forgot '$ssid' so it won't keep the bad password"; }; }
description: Connect To Wi-Fi Network (Prompts Password, Forgets On Failure)

command: name=$(nmcli -t -f NAME,TYPE connection show | sed -n 's/:802-11-wireless$//p' | fzf --prompt='Forget> '); [ -n "$name" ] && nmcli connection delete id "$name"
mac=$(bluetoothctl devices Paired | fzf --prompt='Bluetooth> ' | awk '{print $2}'); [ -n "$mac" ] && bluetoothctl connect "$mac"

bluetoothctl power on >/dev/null; bluetoothctl --timeout 8 scan on >/dev/null; mac=$(bluetoothctl devices | fzf --prompt='Pair> ' | awk '{print $2}'); [ -n "$mac" ] && { bluetoothctl pair "$mac"; bluetoothctl trust "$mac"; bluetoothctl connect "$mac"; }
description: Pair And Connect New Bluetooth Device (Put Device In Pairing Mode)

command: mac=$(bluetoothctl devices Connected | fzf --prompt='Disconnect> ' | awk '{print $2}'); [ -n "$mac" ] && bluetoothctl disconnect "$mac"
mac=$(bluetoothctl devices Paired | fzf --prompt='Remove> ' | awk '{print $2}'); [ -n "$mac" ] && bluetoothctl remove "$mac"
